_meta.source: Public Sector Management Quality Award (PMQA) criteria, B.E. 2562 / 2019 (ADLI/LeTCI, 7 categories, 1000 points)
_meta.source_points_table: Award application and assessment manual, Table 1 (per pmqa_analysis/01_pmqa_criteria_summary.md + 06_pmqa_extension_ooad_design.md)
_meta.note: GOVERNING FILE for the PMQA-2562 rubric, mirrors config/edpex.json's shape exactly (categories[].n/key/title/points/scoring/type/items[].code/title/points). PMQA-2562 uses the SAME ADLI (cat 1-6) / LeTCI (cat 7) scoring paradigm as EdPEx, so app/scoring.php's scoringScheme()/scoringBands()/scoringChoices()/scoringDimCapOk()/scoringValidate() run against PMQA items UNMODIFIED — scoringScheme() keys off categoryN (7=LeTCI else ADLI), not a framework flag, and scoringBands()/scoringChoices() key off the scheme code ('ADLI'/'LeTCI'), which is itself framework-agnostic (same band/percent choice tables). This file supplies category/item/points structure for rendering + rollup only; it is NOT read by scoringValidate()/scoringDimCapOk() at all — those functions needed zero code change to accept a PMQA item. Item-level 'areas' (sub-question guides) are deliberately NOT fully transcribed here (would require translating the full 146-page PMQA-2562 source PDF per item) — this is a structural/points-accurate skeleton sufficient to drive scoring, not a content-complete rubric; flagged honestly rather than forced.
_meta.point_reconciliation: cat1=120 + cat2=80 + cat3=110 + cat4=100 + cat5=90 + cat6=100 + cat7=400 = 1000 (cat7 sub-items 60+70+70+70+60+70=400; an early design note in 06_pmqa_extension_ooad_design.md loosely labelled cat7 '450' but the correct sum per the award-manual point table, doc 01/04, is 400).
